name: Saint Helenian Fishcakes
description: Fishcakes, made with saltfish and mashed potato, are one of Saint Helena's most iconic dishes, reflecting the island's fishing tradition and British culinary heritage.
steps_detailed: Simmer the fish in a little water 8-10 minutes, then flake finely.
Mix the flaked fish with the mashed potato and onion, and shape into small patties.
Fry, turning, 3-4 minutes per side, until golden.
